name: Paging Console — Scheduled Hourly Announcement
description: Use a cron schedule to trigger a pre-configured announcement action on an Axis C6110 paging console at the top of every hour during business hours (08:00–17:00, Mon–Fri). Demonstrates the cron schedule type and the paging_console_execute action. Replace the action_id with the UUID of your configured paging action from the C6110 web interface.
